name: Pictology
hero_text: Hand-painted and handmade pysanky eggs and one-of-a-kind collaged cards, all made by Carole in Brattleboro, Vermont.
about_teaser: I'm a folk artist in Brattleboro, Vermont, and a grandma who never quite stopped playing with color. I've been a batik artist since 1969 and have made pysanky since 1981. Today I hand paint Ukrainian wax-and-dye eggs and make one-of-a-kind collaged cards.
about_body: I make art under the name Pictology from my home in Brattleboro, Vermont. I learned to make pysanky from a friend in 1981, after working primarily as a batik artist since 1969. Pysanky (Ukrainian Easter eggs) are made using the wax-resist and dye-bath process, the same idea as batik. Designs are drawn on raw eggs with melted, colorless beeswax using a stylus tool called a kistka. The egg is then dipped in dye, and wherever the wax goes, the dye can’t go. When the design is complete, the wax is removed, revealing all the colors and patterns underneath. Decorating eggs is a mostly European custom dating back more than 3,000 years. In Ukrainian tradition, each egg is made with a recipient in mind and carries a special message through its symbols and motifs. Only a handful of traditional patterns exist, so the art of pysanky is in the original combination of patterns and colors. Pysanky are considered talismanic: they protect the house and bring good luck to the person who receives them. The egg itself is a symbol of life and renewal. My egg designs are all original, blending ancient symbols with contemporary motifs and colors. I’m inspired by dream images, hymns from the shape-note and Shaker traditions, and other songs and stories I love. My artistic goal is to keep a sense of the ancient tradition while exploring and expanding the limits of traditional techniques. I studied American Studies and Folklore at Marlboro College, and I also make one-of-a-kind collaged cards. I would love to hear from you! Tell me which pieces caught your eye, or share a design you might be interested in. I’m happy to talk about custom work: a pysanka with symbols chosen for a wedding, a new baby or a special birthday, or a set of cards for the holidays. Write to me at cmcrompton51@gmail.com and let’s make something together.
contact_blurb: Questions about an egg or a card, or a design you’d love to see? Carole would love to hear from you, and she’s happy to take custom requests: special symbols, favorite colors, names or dates for a gift.
